author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೈವವಿತ್ತಿಹ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ಗೌರವದಿ ಬದುಕುತಿರು
ಅವನಂತೆ ನಡೆಯುವುದು ಮಾನವನ  ಕರ್ಮ
ಜವರಾಯ ಕರೆದೊಡನೆ ಎಲ್ಲಕೆಲಸವ ಬಿಟ್ಟು
ಅವನೆಡೆಗೆ ಓಡುವೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Live with respect for the gifts God has given;
to walk as he would is a person’s duty;
the moment Yama calls, leaving all your work,
you will run to him, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Honour the life given to you and live by divine example. When death calls, everything is left behind, so live well while there is time.
